description: Mom reveals that Bjarne had been stressed by deadlines and unable to switch off from work.

openingMessages.speaker: Mom
openingMessages.text: Bjarne, can I ask you something? You sounded rather stressed the last time we spoke. Is everything alright at work?

choices.text: Have I been sounding stressed lately?
Work's just been busy. Nothing unusual.
I'm doing fine. You don't need to worry about me.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: A little, yes. You mentioned that work was getting overwhelming.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: You said there were deadlines piling up, and that even when you weren't working, you couldn't stop thinking about work.

choices.text: I think I've forgotten how to be happy outside of work.
I suppose I haven't been looking after myself.
I'll be okay, Mom. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: You always say that. But last time we spoke, you sounded exhausted.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: You told me you were struggling to keep up with everything.

choices.text: I did? I must have been more stressed than I realized.
Maybe I just needed a break.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Alright, honey. I won't push you.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Just remember that I'm here, okay?

choices.text: I'm sorry. I know you're only trying to help.
Thanks, Mom. I'll talk to you later.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Oh, honey... You don't have to figure everything out by yourself.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: You're allowed to be unhappy sometimes. You don't always have to have the answers.

choices.text: I think I need to start listening to that advice.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Well, recognizing it is the first step.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Maybe it's time to slow down a little.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: I know you say that because you don't want me worrying.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: But I am your mother. Worrying comes with the job!

choices.text: I know. Thank you for caring.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: I know, sweetheart. You don't have to apologize for being stressed. Just don't shut everyone out.

lines.speaker: Grand Architect
lines.text: A workload without recovery is not discipline. It's an unsustainable system.

lines.speaker: Pragmatist
lines.text: Have we considered the revolutionary technique of taking a nap?

lines.speaker: Detective
lines.text: Stress, isolation, and a weekend of heavy drinking. The pieces are beginning to fit together.
